H3540.name: Chedorlaomer
H3540.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3540.brief: King of Elam, led coalition against Sodom and Gomorrah
H3540.short: Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, led a coalition of kings against Sodom and Gomorrah and was later defeated by Abraham.

H3562G.name: Conaniah
H3562G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3562G.brief: Levite in charge of offerings during Hezekiah's reign
H3562G.short: Conaniah, a Levite, was in charge of the offerings and distributions during Hezekiah's reign.

H3579.name: Cozbi
H3579.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3579.brief: Midianite woman killed for immorality with an Israelite
H3579.short: Cozbi, a Midianite woman, was killed along with an Israelite man for their immorality.

H3568G.name: Cush
H3568G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3568G.brief: Son of Ham; father of Nimrod and other descendants
H3568G.short: Cush, a son of Ham, was the father of Nimrod and other descendants who became nations.

H3568B.name: Cush
H3568B.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H3568B.brief: Benjamite mentioned in the title of Psalm 7
H3568B.short: Cush, a Benjamite, is mentioned in the title of Psalm 7, which David sang to the Lord.

H3573.name: Cushan-rishathaim
H3573.brief: King of Mesopotamia who oppressed Israel
H3573.short: Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, oppressed Israel for eight years until Othniel defeated him.

H3570.name: Cushi
H3570.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3570.brief: Ancestor of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll
H3570.short: Cushi was the great grandfather of Jehudi, who was sent to fetch Baruch to read Jeremiah's scroll.

H3569H.name: Cushi
H3569H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3569H.short: Cushi was an ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet, mentioned in his genealogy.

H3566.name: Cyrus
H3566.desc: Emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
H3566.brief: Persian Emperor who decreed the rebuilding of the Temple
H3566.short: Cyrus, Emperor of Persia, issued a decree allowing the Jews to return and rebuild the Temple in Jerusalem.

H3506H.name: Ithran
H3506H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3506H.brief: Descendant of Asher, son of Zophah.
H3506H.short: Ithran (or Jether) was a descendant of Asher, the son of Zophah.

H3506G.name: Ithran
H3506G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3506G.brief: Descendant of Esau, son of Dishon the Horite.
H3506G.short: Ithran was a descendant of Esau and son of Dishon the Horite.

H3507.name: Ithream
H3507.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H3507.brief: Son of David, born in Hebron to Eglah.
H3507.short: Ithream was a son of David, born to him in Hebron by his wife Eglah.

H3505.name: Ithrites
H3505.brief: Clan descended from Kiriath-jearim; two of David's warriors.
H3505.short: The Ithrites were a clan descended from Kiriath-jearim (<ref="1Ch.2.53">1Ch.2.53</ref>), and two of David's mighty warriors, Ira and Gareb, were Ithrites.

H3500I.name: Jether
H3500I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3500I.brief: A son of Jada from the tribe of Judah.
H3500I.short: Jether was a son of Jada, a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

H3500J.name: Jether
H3500J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H3500J.brief: Son of Ezrah; brother of Mered, Epher and Jalon
H3500J.short: Jether, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H3500H.name: Jether
H3500H.desc: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
H3500H.short: Jether, also known as Ithra, was an Ishmaelite and the father of Amasa, who was Absalom's commander and later killed by Joab.

H3500G.name: Jether
H3500G.brief: Gideon's firstborn son who refused to kill captives.
H3500G.short: Jether was Gideon's firstborn son who was commanded to kill Zebah and Zalmunna but was too young and fearful to do so.

H3509.name: Jetheth
H3509.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H3509.short: Jetheth, one of the chiefs of Edom.

H3503.name: Jethro
H3503.desc: Midianite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H3503.short: Jethro, also known as Reuel, was Moses' father-in-law and a priest of Midian.

H3565.name: Bor-ashan
H3565.short: Bor-ashan, a town in southern Judah, was one of the places where David sent spoils from his victory over the Amalekites.

H3522.name: Cabbon
H3522.short: Cabbon was a town in the lowlands of Judah.

H3521H.name: Cabul
H3521H.brief: Name given to 20 cities by Hiram
H3521H.short: Cabul was the name given by Hiram, king of Tyre, to the twenty cities given to him by Solomon.

H3521G.name: Cabul
H3521G.short: Cabul was a border town in the territory of Asher.

H3529.name: Chebar
H3529.brief: River in Babylonia; location of Ezekiel's visions
H3529.short: The Chebar River was a waterway in Babylonia near which the prophet Ezekiel received visions from God during the Babylonian exile.

H3568A.name: Cush
H3568A.brief: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon
H3568A.short: Cush, often translated as Ethiopia, was an ancient region in Africa, mentioned in various contexts throughout the Bible.

H3572.name: Cushan
H3572.brief: Unknown location, possibly related to Cush
H3572.short: Cushan, a location mentioned in <ref="Habakkuk 3:7">Habakkuk 3:7</ref>, is possibly related to Cush or another unidentified place.

H3575.name: Cuthah
H3575.brief: Babylonian city; origin of Samaritan settlers
H3575.short: Cuthah was a Babylonian city from which the Assyrian king brought people to settle in Samaria after the deportation of the Israelites.

H3526G.name: Washer's Field
H3526G.brief: A location near Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in prophecies
H3526G.short: The Washer's Field, a location near Jerusalem's wall, where the Assyrian officials stood and delivered messages to King Hezekiah (<ref="2Kgs. 18:17; Isa. 7:3; 36:2">2Kgs. 18:17; Isa. 7:3; 36:2</ref>).

H3594.name: Kiyyun
H3594.brief: Astral deity worshiped by Israelites, provoking God's judgment
H3594.short: Kiyyun was an astral deity that the Israelites worshiped, leading to God's judgment and their exile.

H3598.name: Pleiades
H3598.brief: A star cluster mentioned as a display of God's power
H3598.short: The Pleiades are a star cluster mentioned in <ref="Job.9.9; 38:31">Job.9.9; 38:31</ref> as a display of God's creative power and in <ref="Amo.5.8">Amo.5.8</ref> as evidence of God's control over the natural world.
